Description: Oikos University, a private post-secondary educational institution, operates its acupuncture and East Asian medicine degree program at this location. The site houses classroom lecture instruction and a supervised student teaching clinic in which enrolled student interns provide acupuncture and related East Asian medicine treatments to members of the public under the direct on-site supervision of California-licensed acupuncturists. This use is a continuation of the same teaching clinic and instructional use previously operated at this address by the Acupuncture & Integrative Medicine College (AIMC).
